name: Ane Kiss @ Home ~Koi Suru Onee-chan to Ecchi na Nichijou~
original_name: 姉キス＠Home～恋するお姉ちゃんとえっちな日常～
source:
The protagonist, Misato Fukui (name changeable), lives a lively and harmonious life surrounded by his three unique sisters.
One day, his father remarries, and he gains an older stepsister, Yuuka, who’s just one year his senior.
Yuuka is shy and struggles to fit in with the family, and Misato can’t just leave her be.

But his three sisters aren’t exactly calm about the situation.
The eldest sister clings to him, showering him with affection as if to show Yuuka how close they are.
The middle sister pretends not to care, but behind the scenes, she aggressively seeks out intimate moments.
The youngest sister, torn by her growing feelings for her brother, can’t stop herself from acting on them.

At home and at school, the sisters try to tempt the guy.
Will Misato’s school life and the peace of the Fukui household hold… or will it all come crashing down!?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210617051744/http://spielsoft.1000.tv/LoveJuice/anekiss/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公福井美里（化名）在三个性格各异的姐妹的陪伴下，过着活泼和谐的生活。
有一天，他的父亲再婚，他有了一个比他大一岁的继姐妹优香。
优香很害羞，很难融入这个家庭，美里不能就这样放任她不管。

但他的三个姐妹对这种情况并不平静。
大姐紧紧地抱住他，对他充满爱意，仿佛是在向优香展示他们之间的亲密关系。
二姐假装不在意，但在幕后却积极寻找亲密时刻。
最小的妹妹因对哥哥日益增长的感情而感到痛苦，无法阻止自己对他们采取行动。

在家里和学校，姐妹们都试图引诱这个男人。
美里的学校生活和福井家的平静能否维持下去……还是会彻底崩溃！？

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210617051744/http://spielsoft.1000.tv/LoveJuice/anekiss/index.html]官网[/url]]
